name: CallOptions
desc: Runtime options for an RPC.

name: CallOptions.new
desc: Creates a CallOptions object.

name: ChannelCredentials
desc: Options controlling TLS security settings on a ClientChannel.

name: ChannelCredentials.insecure
desc: Disable TLS. RPCs are sent in clear text.

name: ChannelCredentials.secure
desc:
Enable TLS and optionally specify the certificates to trust. If
certificates is not provided, the default trust store is used.

name: ChannelOptions
desc: Options controlling how connections are made on a ClientChannel.

name: connectTimeout
desc:
The maximum allowed time to wait for a connection to be established.
If connectTimeout is longer than the system level timeout duration,
a timeout may occur sooner than specified in connectTimeout.

name: connectionTimeout
desc: The maximum time a single connection will be used for new requests.

name: Client
desc: Base class for client stubs.

name: Client.new
desc: Interceptors will be applied in direct order before making a request.

name: ClientChannel
desc: A channel to a virtual gRPC endpoint.

name: createCall
desc: Initiates a new RPC on this connection.

name: getConnection
desc: Returns a connection to this Channel's RPC endpoint.

name: host
desc:
Starts the Server with the given options.
address can be either a String or an InternetAddress, in the latter
case it can be a Unix Domain Socket address.

name: onConnectionStateChanged
desc: Stream of connection state changes

name: shutdown
desc: Shuts down this channel.

name: terminate
desc: Terminates this channel.

name: ClientInterceptor
desc: ClientInterceptors intercepts client calls before they are executed.

name: ClientKeepAliveOptions
desc:
KeepAlive support for gRPC, see
https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/keepalive.md.
Options to configure a gRPC client for sending keepalive signals.

name: permitWithoutCalls
desc:
If a connection with no active calls should be kept alive by sending
pings.

name: pingInterval
desc: How often a ping should be sent to keep the connection alive.

name: timeout
desc:
How long the connection should wait before shutting down after no response
to a ping.

name: GrpcError.aborted
desc:
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue like
sequencer check failures, transaction aborts, etc.

name: GrpcError.alreadyExists
desc:
Some entity that we attempted to create (e.g., file or directory) already
exists.

name: GrpcError.cancelled
desc: The operation was cancelled (typically by the caller).

name: GrpcError.custom
desc: Custom error code.

name: GrpcError.dataLoss
desc: Unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

name: GrpcError.deadlineExceeded
desc:
Deadline expired before operation could complete. For operations that
change the state of the system, this error may be returned even if the
operation has completed successfully. For example, a successful response
from a server could have been delayed long enough for the deadline to
expire.

name: GrpcError.failedPrecondition
desc:
Operation was rejected because the system is not in a state required for
the operation's execution. For example, directory to be deleted may be
non-empty, an rmdir operation is applied to a non-directory, etc.

name: GrpcError.internal
desc:
Internal errors. Means some invariants expected by underlying system has
been broken. If you see one of these errors, something is very broken.

name: GrpcError.invalidArgument
desc:
Client specified an invalid argument. Note that this differs from
failedPrecondition. invalidArgument indicates arguments that are
problematic regardless of the state of the system (e.g., a malformed file
name).

name: GrpcError.notFound
desc: Some requested entity (e.g., file or directory) was not found.

name: GrpcError.ok
desc: The operation completed successfully.

name: GrpcError.outOfRange
desc:
Operation was attempted past the valid range. E.g., seeking or reading
past end of file.

name: GrpcError.permissionDenied
desc:
The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation.
permissionDenied must not be used for rejections caused by exhausting
some resource (use resourceExhausted instead for those errors).
permissionDenied must not be used if the caller cannot be identified
(use unauthenticated instead for those errors).

name: GrpcError.resourceExhausted
desc:
Some resource has been exhausted, perhaps a per-user quota, or perhaps the
entire file system is out of space.

name: GrpcError.unauthenticated
desc:
The request does not have valid authentication credentials for the
operation.

name: GrpcError.unavailable
desc:
The service is currently unavailable.  This is a most likely a transient
condition and may be corrected by retrying with a backoff.

name: GrpcError.unimplemented
desc: Operation is not implemented or not supported/enabled in this service.

name: GrpcError.unknown
desc:
Unknown error. An example of where this error may be returned is if a
Status value received from another address space belongs to an error-space
that is not known in this address space. Also errors raised by APIs that
do not return enough error information may be converted to this error.

name: codeName
desc: Given a status code, return the name

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: Interceptor
desc: A gRPC Interceptor.

name: ServerCredentials
desc: Wrapper around grpc_server_credentials, a way to authenticate a server.

name: securityContext

Creates SecurityContext from these credentials if possible.
Otherwise returns null.

name: validateClient

Validates incoming connection. Returns true if connection is
allowed to proceed.

name: ServerInterceptor
desc: A gRPC Interceptor.

name: ServerKeepAliveOptions
desc: Options to configure a gRPC server for receiving keepalive signals.

name: maxBadPings
desc:
The maximum number of bad pings that the server will tolerate before
sending an HTTP2 GOAWAY frame and closing the transport.

name: minIntervalBetweenPingsWithoutData
desc: The minimum time that is expected between receiving successive pings.

name: ServerLocalCredentials
desc: Set of credentials that only allows local TCP connections.

name: securityContext
desc:
Creates SecurityContext from these credentials if possible.
Otherwise returns null.

name: validateClient
desc:
Validates incoming connection. Returns true if connection is
allowed to proceed.

name: Service
desc: Definition of a gRPC service.

name: $onMetadata
desc: Client metadata handler.

name: ServiceCall
desc: Server-side context for a gRPC call.

name: clientCertificate
desc: Returns the client certificate if it is requested and available

name: clientMetadata
desc: Custom metadata from the client.

name: deadline
desc:
Deadline for this call. If the call is still active after this time, then
the client or server may cancel it.

name: headers
desc:
Custom metadata to be sent to the client. Will be null once the headers
have been sent, either when sendHeaders is called, or when the first
response message is sent.

name: isCanceled
desc: Returns true if the client has canceled this call.

name: isTimedOut
desc: Returns true if the deadline has been exceeded.

name: remoteAddress
desc: Returns the IP address of the client, if available

name: sendHeaders
desc:
Send response headers. This is done automatically before sending the first
response message, but can be done manually before the first response is
ready, if necessary.

name: sendTrailers
desc:
Send response trailers. A trailer indicating success (status == 0) will
be sent automatically when all responses are sent. This method can be used
to send a different status code, if needed.

name: trailers
desc: Custom metadata to be sent to the client after all response messages.

name: ServiceMethod
